disputes.policyDescription: How Cnote resolves disputes between buyers and sellers: evidence-based, fast, and always open to human review.
disputes.policyIntro: If something goes wrong with an order, you can report it from the order page. We collect the evidence, prepare a neutral summary, and a person makes the decision unless the case is small and clear-cut.
disputes.step1Body: Tell us what happened, the amount involved, and attach photos, documents or a voice note in your own language.
disputes.step2Body: The other party has 72 hours to add their account and evidence. We also attach the order, quote and conversation automatically.
disputes.step3Body: Our AI prepares a summary, checks the claim against the agreed order and recommends an outcome. It never decides on its own.
disputes.step4Body: A trained adjudicator decides using that summary. Small, clear cases up to Rs 5,000 may be settled automatically, and either side can ask for a person instead within 48 hours.
disputes.step5Body: Escrowed funds stay frozen during the dispute and are released or refunded as decided. The outcome is recorded on both businesses' trust history.
disputes.appealBody: If you disagree with a decision you can appeal once within 7 days from your dispute page, and a second reviewer will look at it.
disputes.legalNote: This policy is a summary for users and is subject to final legal review. The full terms of service apply.
disputes.reportTitle: Report a problem with this order
disputes.reportIntro: Tell us what went wrong. The other side will be asked to respond within 72 hours.
disputes.detailsHint: Include dates, quantities and what was agreed. You can also record a voice note.
disputes.amountHint: Leave empty if you are not sure. It cannot be more than the order value.
disputes.voiceConsent: I agree that my voice note may be stored and transcribed to help resolve this dispute.
disputes.heading: Dispute
disputes.status_open: Open, waiting for the other side
disputes.proposalBody: We propose this outcome because the case is small and the evidence is clear. If you disagree, ask for a person to decide before {date}.
disputes.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
